description: Superficie de zones urbanisées situées en zone inondable (en Ha et en %) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. LOCATION: sde.orn.SDECOMMUNEMESURES --- YEAR: 2009 --- FORMAT: vector --- DETAIL: - Crossing of information layers "flood zones" and "urbanised areas" - Crossing of the previous result "with the "commons", - From the result obtained, calculation of the area of area urbanised in a flood-prone area by municipality: in Ha and in %. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Area of urbanised areas in flood zone (in Ha and in %)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2009-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
